parse.tooLong: Keep formulas to {maximum} characters or fewer.
parse.tooDeep: Nesting goes more than {maximum} levels deep at position {position}. Simplify the formula.
parse.tooManyNodes: Use at most {maximum} numbers, references, operators and calls in one formula.
parse.unexpectedCharacter: “{found}” at position {position} is not part of a formula.
parse.unexpectedToken: “{found}” at position {position} is out of place.
parse.unexpectedEnd: The formula ends too early. Add a number, reference or closing bracket at the end.
parse.invalidReference: “{found}” at position {position} is not a reference. References look like @level.
parse.unknownFunction: “{found}” at position {position} is not a function. Character values start with @, like @level.
parse.notCalled: “{found}” at position {position} is a function. Call it with brackets, like {found}(…).
parse.argumentCount: {name} takes {expected, plural, one {# value} other {# values}}, not {given} (position {position}).
parse.argumentCountAtLeast: {name} needs at least {minimum, plural, one {# value} other {# values}} (position {position}).

evaluate.divisionByZero: The division at position {position} divides by zero.
evaluate.outOfRange: The value at position {position} is out of range. Values must stay between −{maximum} and {maximum}.
